vulnerability.name: GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm
vulnerability.description: braces: stack-exhaustion denial of service through deeply nested brace patterns

statements.impact_statement: braces is in site/pnpm-lock.yaml only, the docs site's build tooling, through micromatch 4.0.8, which only starlight-llms-txt 0.11.0 depends on (its generator.ts matches page ids against the include, exclude, promote and demote patterns). Those patterns are the ones site/astro.config.ts sets, so the nested patterns the advisory needs would have to be committed to this repository, and the worst they do is crash a docs build. Nothing in site/ ships in a crate, wheel or npm package. Re-check if the site starts taking glob patterns from anything other than its own config, or when braces publishes a fixed release.
